residuals.layer_norm_no_affine: Mean-subtracting LayerNorm eps=1e-6; RMSNorm is not equivalent.
residuals.condition_timestep_modulation: Shared scale and gate rows select timestep zero for prefix, actual timestep for target; scale uses 1+s.
residuals.image_qkv: Three bias-free 4096x4096 projections; existing linear roles are candidates, weight bindings remain unimplemented.
residuals.image_three_axis_rope: Interleaved complex rotation, axes 16/56/56, centered spatial grid, theta=10000; not text RoPE.
residuals.image_block_causal_attention: Text causal, image blocks bidirectional, invalid prompt keys excluded; fixed prefix KV reused across denoising, not autoregressive append.
residuals.image_output_projection: Bias-free 4096x4096 projection with image module binding, not registered.
residuals.image_ffn_gate_up: Separate gate_layer and proj weights, each 12288x4096; concatenate only after proving packing parity.
residuals.image_ffn_down: Bias-free 4096x12288 output projection, native binding and precision path unimplemented.
residuals.qwen3_vl_image_slot_preprocess: Tokenizer/image slots and condition-image alignment; not plain text tokenization.
residuals.qwen3_vl_joint_embedding_export: Encoder text and vision features exported before LM head, with image-slot alignment.
residuals.rgba_vae_encode: Four-channel residual spatial/temporal VAE, normalization by 64 latent means/stds.
residuals.flow_euler_iteration: Explicit timestep/sigma schedule, latent updates and request-owned prefix cache lifecycle.
residuals.rgba_vae_decode: Inverse latent normalization, residual convolutions/upsampling and RGBA output.
residuals.text_projection_zero_center_norm: FP32 RMSNorm with effective weight 1+w then linear/GELU-tanh/linear.
residuals.timestep_sinusoidal_embedding: 256-wide sinusoid at 1000*t with learned projection; shared 4*4096 modulation.
residuals.final_adaptive_layer_norm: Scale-only LayerNorm and target timestep selection before 4096-to-64 latent projection.
